note: Attacker-controlled raw SMTP bytes (MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, BDAT, DATA commands) are fed to the server connection via the fuzz fd.
A DATA command stores its data input stream in the shared connection state data_input.

When a DATA/BDAT command is destroyed (chunk_last=TRUE or not replied successfully), it frees the shared conn->state.data_input stream even though a subsequent pipelined DATA command still references it.
A subsequent pipelined DATA command begins and passes the already-freed conn->state.data_input to the data_begin callback.
The fuzz callback stores the dangling pointer to the freed data input stream in global state.data_input.
Input handling for the subsequent DATA command invokes the data_continue callback with the dangling stream.
i_stream_read() dereferences the freed data_input stream, causing the heap-use-after-free READ 8 crash.
